agentGuidance.purpose: Fill operator-provisioned credentials into explicitly selected browser inputs without returning the secret to the agent.
agentGuidance.when: Use only after the operator has provisioned the key and while its time window is active.
agentGuidance.recipe: Discover keyvault.write_to_input_box, provide the vault key and exact username/password selectors, then submit the form. Never ask for or echo the credential.
agentGuidance.boundaries: The capability does not reveal, return, or copy credentials. The host rejects requests outside the entry window or URL allowlist.
